drift_warning.direction: Every rejection that changes the reader's impression pushed the same way, toward making Tatitlek look further behind, thinner staffed and more exposed than the fetched evidence supports.
mechanisms_seen: Absence of evidence became evidence of absence, twice. Five pages showing no AI became a zero AI posture. A job board showing no Alaska listings became zero Alaska hiring.
A staffed function was read as an unstaffed one.
Counts drifted upward toward roundness and severity. 31 became roughly 33. An unstable 148 to 150 became a flat 150. A 3x multiple became a hard 6.
Time horizons and tenures were extended without sources.
A quotation was invented for a named person.
drift_warning.the_corrected_premise: The verified record is a company with 1,300 employees, five published vehicles, a nearly $100 million ceiling award, a staffed BD and proposal function, a capture AI tool already in use, and a live $130,000 requisition to add capacity to it. Build for that company. The honest opening is not that they have no AI, it is that they already put GovEagle in the pipeline.

GOVEAGLE_FINDING.what_changed: The showrunner retired the riskiest assumption in the analysis by fetching GovEagle's own pages, which the run had not done.
GOVEAGLE_FINDING.verified: GovEagle already covers past-performance matching, task-area matching, capability matrix, compliance matrix, RFP shredding, pWin and bid/no-bid, and its AI drafting layer already pulls from past-performance write-ups (C48, C49, C50, C51).
GOVEAGLE_FINDING.consequence: The provisional pick, a Key Personnel and Past Performance Evidence Engine, is DEAD on its past-performance half. Proposing it would have offered a duplicate of a tool they already bought, to the VP of Business Development who runs it.
GOVEAGLE_FINDING.still_open: Whether GovEagle handles key-personnel RESUMES is UNVERIFIED. Not named on any page fetched, asserted only by search summaries. The study must state this as what we could and could not find, never as a finding in either direction, and must recommend the question be put to them directly.
GOVEAGLE_FINDING.not_covered_anywhere: DATA CALLS appear on no GovEagle page fetched. The orchestration of who across 46 locations and seven subsidiaries owns which answer is outside everything named.
